European wheel: 37 pockets, one zero.

Place chips on numbers, lines, corners or outside bets, then spin. Straight pays 35 to 1, split 17, street 11, corner 8, six line 5, dozen or column 2, red/black, odd/even, low/high 1.

Zero loses outside bets. Chips you have not spun return when you leave.

Serve a ball into the board. It hops left or right off one post in each of 12 rows and lands in one of 13 courts, which pays its multiplier times your stake.

Centre courts are the most likely; edge courts are rare and pay the most. Risk changes the multipliers, not the odds: every table returns 95.996% over time.

The court is decided when you serve.

Eight-deck Punto Banco, shuffled for every coup. Back the hand that ends closer to 9.

Player pays 1 to 1. Banker pays 1 to 1 less 5% commission: 19 for every 20. Tie pays 8 to 1, and Player and Banker bets push on a tie. Pairs pay 11 to 1.

Aces count 1, tens and courts 0. Third cards follow the fixed tableau.
